newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to provide loan to Albania for power project.
newsitem.headline: Japan to provide loan to Albania for power project.

text.p: Japan's Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund said on Thursday it had signed a contract to provide Albania with a loan of 3.12 billion yen for a power transmission and distribution project.
The fund, a government agency that provides concessionary financing for long-term development, said in a statement that the funds will be used to buy equipment necessary for the project.
The cumulative total of the fund's loan commitments to Albania now stands at 6.97 billion yen, the statement said.
